title: impossible-case-default-with-throw (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: All declared string literals are covered by switch cases. The defensive default throw is unreachable for conforming inputs.

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics. Constant-condition diagnostics measure broad behavior, not a recommendation that every redundancy deserves a product warning. Measured with PHP 8.3.35, PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.0 and Mago 1.57.0. phpstan false_negative: missing required diagnostic(s): deadCode.unreachable; psalm false_negative: missing required diagnostic(s): ParadoxicalCondition; mago false_negative: missing required diagnostic(s): unreachable-code. All three tools omit the unreachable-default diagnostic. This is a deliberate broad reachability criterion, not a recommendation to warn on defensive throws. Psalm implementation only checks impossible defaults in handleNonReturningCase; that explains its silence here but is not substituted for a documented unsupported policy. The required codes are existing tool diagnostic codes, not invented switch-specific identifiers.
